scope: Static clarification only. No code modification, privilege change, platform retry, tests, state calls or comparison cells.

required_rights.current_volume_open: GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, OPEN_EXISTING on \\.\C:
required_rights.current_volume_flush: Administrative volume access; no raw-sector write is performed.
required_rights.ordinary_file_operations: Private file/directory creation, write, read and appropriate rename permissions; file flush requires GENERIC_WRITE.
required_rights.error_cause_limit: Error 5 and a non-elevated process are recorded. No complete ACL/token/security-filter diagnosis was performed.

volume_necessity.basis: The source requires volume flush; Windows also documents file-scoped flush and handle-based no-replace rename.

required: Successful data and relevant metadata barriers
Durable names and required directory entries
Final barrier before final verification and terminal record
Read-only recovery without retry or marker fabrication
guarantees.readability: Integrity observation only; not an independent durability proof.
guarantees.terminal_flush_exception: Existing S2-EH read-only recovery after a prior successful final flush does not independently prove the terminal record's own durability.
guarantees.hardware_limit: No unconditional physical power-loss guarantee; assumes a correctly behaving storage stack. No crash or power-loss test performed.

error_5.s2em: Constructor failed before scratch or real reservation creation.
error_5.real_attempt_already_reserved_rule: Remain consumed; FAILED or ABORTED_INCOMPLETE as applicable; no readability-based completion before the final barrier.

narrower_path.proposed_for_future_contract: File-scoped NTFS publication with private file rights, bound file handles/barriers and no-replace rename; no volume handle.
open_obligations: Durable reservation and parent-directory creation before any cell
Data and metadata coverage of the exact no-replace publication
Reservation, journal, artifact and terminal-record durability and fail-closed ordering
Fresh source/plan binding and separately authorized target-platform acceptance
not_accepted: Use diagnostic recorder as equivalent publisher
Treat file-only flush as proven coverage for every directory entry

external_sources.role: Reject existing rename target with ReplaceIfExists false
